name: Customer data sharing — acceptance test
purpose: Review whether customer data may be shared with an external analytics provider to reduce weekly reporting work. This acceptance test uses synthetic evidence only.
question: Under what conditions may customer data be shared with an external analytics provider? Distinguish a synthetic pilot from production use, identify missing evidence, and explain when human review, stopping and reassessment are required.
goals: Measure report preparation time, review time, corrections and cost. No baseline or achieved improvement has been measured.
